description: The North Carolina collection indexes more than ten thousand one-dimensional HEC-RAS river models exposed through FIMAN. They describe channel geometry, structures and floodplains from work by public agencies and consultants over several decades. This resource is provided by Lauren Grimley. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This state collection depends on the local-instance policy; model assumptions, calibration and documentation vary substantially. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
